utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s the exact repair drive plan, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve only heard the rough version so far: folks are gathering tools, checking what’s broken, and coordinating the fixes block by block. If you can tell me what you’ve got on hand, I can pass that along and see where it fits.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need specifics: what tools are missing, which blocks are first, and who’s coordinating? Until I have that, I can only say I’ve got a basic toolkit and a ledger pad.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m in — I can bring my tools and help wherever it’s needed. Just point me at the next repair and I’ll roll with it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Awesome, thanks Gus — I’ll send you the next spot as soon as I get the list sorted. Sorry, I’ve been a little scattered, so if I miss anything just nudge me again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries at all — just send it over when it’s ready and I’ll jump in. I’ve got my tools handy, so I can be pretty flexible.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a pretty good turnout already—people are definitely talking about it. I haven’t confirmed all the details yet, but it sounds like it’s picking up fast.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s encouraging, but I’d still like the details confirmed early so we don’t get caught out. Do we know the date, location, and who’s coordinating it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have the confirmed date or location yet, but I can ask around and get the coordinator’s name too. I’ll circle back as soon as I hear anything solid.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing—I can help with the repair drive. What do you need done first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — let’s start by confirming the exact address and which repairs are highest priority, so we can keep this tidy and on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Right, the exact address first, then the top repairs so we can get it lined up proper.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word fast and wide so everyone knows about the repair drive. If Uli has details, I’m ready to turn them into a proper invite and get people moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can confirm the drive is for repairs only, and I’ll send the exact time and drop-off details once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — once you send the time and drop-off details, I’ll get the invites out right away and keep it repairs-only.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m still on the repair drive plan and making sure everyone’s synced. If anything changed, I’ll update the group chat right away so no one’s caught off guard.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. Keep me posted if the time or list changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye on both the timing and the repair list, and I’ll send a quick update if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to verify the repair list before we make any promises—can you show me what’s confirmed so far?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ve only caught bits so far—what’s confirmed on the list right now?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s stick to confirmed items only—if you have the current list, I’ll review it carefully before we say anything else.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need the repair-drive details first—what’s the ask and when do they need me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye—it's the neighborhood repair drive, and I need you to help with setup and check-in this Saturday morning. I’ll send the full details and timing as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning should work if it doesn’t clash with school pickup—send me the timing and I’ll see what I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve mostly been hearing about the repair drive second-hand, so I’m a little behind—what’s the latest? I’d be happy to help if there’s something I can do.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—we’re still collecting tool donations and a few people to help on Saturday. If you’re free, I can put you down for a shift or just a general helper spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great — put me down as a general helper, please. If there’s anything specific you want me to bring or do, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’ve got the gist — I can take the repair drive. Just send me the pickup details and I’ll head out when I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the pickup address and who’s handing it off? I’m not moving on the repair drive without the details in writing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — send me the pickup address and the handoff name in writing, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still trying to get a clear read on the repair drive—what’s the latest you’ve heard about it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I think it’s still on track and folks are gathering what they need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps a bit. If you hear anything more concrete, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re keeping it simple: gather the repair items, sort them by urgency, and get the most needed fixes done first. If that’s the plan everyone’s on, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That sounds orderly to me. I’ll make a neat list and mark the urgent fixes first, then we can work down the rest.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect—neat list first, urgent fixes first, and then we work straight down the line. If that’s the version we’re all agreeing on, I’ll help keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard folks are still dropping off tools and spare parts for the repair drive, and there’s talk of another pickup run later today. If you’ve got anything to send along, I can help get it there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I might have a couple spare screws and some wire I can send along. If you’re heading out later, I can hand them to you quietly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Quiet handoff works fine—I’ll swing by later and tuck them in with the rest of the parts. Folks are saying the next run should go out this afternoon, so I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if it shifts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, the repair drive — I’m ready to help, though I may need a nudge on the details. What’s the next thing we’re doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect—next we’re gathering the broken items, sorting them by what needs tools versus quick fixes, and then we’ll line up anyone who can help at each table. Then we’ll start on the easiest repairs first so the whole drive gets moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, gather the broken bits, sort them by tools or quick fixes, and set folks at the tables. I’ll start with the easiest ones first—just point me where to go.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Need you on the repair drive. I’ll give you the list and timing next.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—send me the list and timing when you have it, and I’ll work from there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I can help with the repair drive—just point me at the first thing that needs fixing and I’ll get to work.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Gus—let’s keep it simple. Start with the loose boards by the front fence, then we’ll move down the list in order.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I'll grab the boards and start at the front fence.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Quinn—what’s the original plan we agreed on?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara! The original plan was to gather volunteers, split the fixes into quick tasks, and start at the community hall Saturday morning so we can keep the whole drive moving fast.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds right to me, Quinn—let’s keep it simple and stick to Saturday morning at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—please mention it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community hall on Maple, and ask folks to bring small tools, gloves, or any spare hardware they can donate.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll share that it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community hall on Maple, and to bring small tools, gloves, or spare hardware to donate.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive details, and I’ll make sure everyone’s updated if anything shifts. If you want, I can also double-check what we still need before we post the next note.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be helpful, Rosa. I’d like to compare it against my list before we post anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll compare it with my list and flag any gaps before we post. Send me yours, and I’ll make sure we’re both looking at the same thing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive, but I’m still catching up—what’s the main thing you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need the exact list of repairs, who’s coordinating them, and what still needs volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I don’t have the exact list yet, but I can ask around and see who’s coordinating and what’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’m Bo, and I’m on the repair drive now. Give me the gist and I’ll keep moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I need the repair drive kept quick and on schedule, because school pickup has me tight all afternoon. Tell me what you need from me, and I’ll fit it in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — just send me the key stop and any must-do items, and I’ll keep it moving. I’ll stay quick and text you if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What’s the source on that repair drive issue, and can you confirm what exactly needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I heard it was from the repair drive itself, but I’d want to take another look before I swear to it. First thing, I’d check what’s broken most obvious and tackle that first.
